collectionName.label: Collection Name
collectionName.help: Name for this memory collection (user namespace)

indexType.label: FAISS Index Type
indexType.help: Index type: flat (exact), hnsw (fast), ivf (balanced), ivf_pq (compressed), pq (quantized)

embeddingDims.label: Embedding Dimensions
embeddingDims.help: Must match your Ollama embedding model (nomic-embed-text=512, mxbai=768)

storagePath.label: Storage Path
storagePath.help: Directory to store FAISS index and metadata

hnswEfSearch.label: HNSW EF Search
hnswEfSearch.help: Search time accuracy vs speed tradeoff (default: 32)

ollamaLlmModel.label: Ollama LLM Model
ollamaLlmModel.help: Model for memory extraction (optional but recommended)

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically store conversation context after each agent turn

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

topK.label: Top K Results
topK.help: Maximum number of memories to retrieve

searchThreshold.label: Search Threshold
searchThreshold.help: Minimum similarity score for search results (0-1)
